query:
SELECT 
  u.id as userId,
  u.name,
  u.role,
  m.tenantId,
  t.name as tenantName
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN memberships m ON u.id = m.userId
LEFT JOIN tenants t ON m.tenantId = t.id
WHERE u.role IN ('admin_bp', 'analyst_bp');
